description: Quetzal provides a Python modelling library for transport planning and traffic forecasts. The provider is SYSTRA. Geographical and temporal coverage: SYSTRA documents application to large cities and provides package installation instructions. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is CeCILL-B. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The README does not guarantee backward compatibility and advises pinning the package version used in a project. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration.
